body.title: Guard the authoring routes
body.summary: Call the gate with action author in the workflow-step phases (src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/phases) and in the daemon's server-side driver (runWorkflowServerSide and its runStart stream handler in src/daemon/workflow-rpc.ts) at its start and before it writes the draft, each deriving its UnitRef from the request it holds. A held-by-other outcome throws TeamGateRefusedError before any state changes; the first-author exception lets the one first draft through. Analyze and code review get no call.
acceptanceChecks: workflow-step start, plan, step and synthesize on a stage held by someone else are refused naming the holder before any state changes
runWorkflowServerSide and the workflow.run done path are refused for a non-holder before the draft is written
The first author turn of a stage with no issue is let through
A repo with no policy behaves as before

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/__tests__/gate-call-sites.test.ts: workflow-step start, plan, step and synthesize on a stage held by someone else are refused naming the holder before any state changes, the first author turn with no issue is let through, and a repo without a policy behaves as before
